item.title: Ruri 0.10.6
item.description:
> 全面优化了 App 与命令行中的中英文文本，用词更统一、表达更自然。同时修复了切换主题后外观不同步的问题。 > > Polished Chinese and English text throughout the app and CLI for more consistent, natural wording. Also fixed the appearance not staying in sync when switching themes.
- chore(release): bump version to 0.10.6 (ab00194) - fix(i18n): polish Chinese copy across the app and CLI (8321bfe) - fix(ui): keep appearance in sync when switching themes (6ca5074) - chore(dev): debug the packaged app and isolate data from VS Code (cc9b9c8) - fix(update): disable Sparkle in ad hoc signed builds (4496fff) - chore: license Ruri under GPL-3.0 (de4ada0) - fix(i18n): polish English translations across the app and CLI (a4d4700)

item.title: Ruri 0.10.5
item.description:
> Ruri 新增英文界面，默认跟随系统语言。系统语言为英文时会显示英文，可在「设置 → 外观 → 语言」切回简体中文。 > > Ruri now has an English interface and follows the system language by default. To change it, go to Settings → Appearance → Language.
- fix(release): find sign_update in the per-architecture build folder (b066a28) - chore(release): bump version to 0.10.5 (a368773) - fix(settings): show the language restart hint only after a change (935a803) - refactor(i18n): keep the language choice only in AppleLanguages (3d3d5d7) - fix(i18n): polish English terminology and casing (268c6f5) - feat(i18n): add English localization (de1059d) - fix(i18n): remove hard-coded Chinese grammar from composed text (849576f) - feat(i18n): track translation coverage, staleness and plural rules (092886a) - feat(i18n): fall back through English and sync AppKit language (40b40c3) - refactor(i18n): migrate to string catalogs with stable message keys (afa74f0) - ci: cross-compile Intel builds with the Xcode that tests arm64 (40e6e6c)
